The first meeting of all sections of LAS 101 will be a Course Orientation held on Wednesday, Aug. 30, 2006 at 4:00 in Foellinger Auditorium. All LAS 101 students must attend the five Global Studies lectures in Foellinger Auditorium from 4:00 - 5:30 p.m. on the following Wednesdays: Sept. 20, Oct. 4, Oct. 18, Nov. 1, Nov. 15.
